seed_selection: This regression case deliberately reuses staircase-v1 seeds 1 through 10 so the final traversal policy can be compared with the accepted milestone-1 trajectories. The seeds remain in their original order and include reference seed 6.
step_cap_rationale: The 1000-step cap is reused unchanged from staircase-v1. It is long enough for the accepted exploration policy on these fixed maps while bounding hunger-limited failures, and was fixed before any staircase-v2 episode ran.
